hook: Every month, international students *lose money*, between two currencies.
pain: Hidden exchange margins. Tuition deadlines. New payment apps. No credit history.
agent: An AI agent that *does the work*. It reads your invoice, checks your balances, pulls live rates, compares *seventeen* providers, and prepares the payment.
approve: But it *never* moves money on its own. Every action is a card *you* approve, sealed with a fingerprint of its exact terms.
rails: Money moves on *real* rails. Top up with Alipay or your card. Pay anyone in China, straight into their Alipay.
features: Every currency you live in, valued live. Tuition set aside so it is never spent. Budgets, runway, and a plan to build credit in China.
secure: Built like a bank, and attacked by its own tests on every release.
